AI changes the game – trust sets the rules

Tech & AI

Nordea was once again strongly represented at this year's Nordic Fintech Week. Kirsten Renner, Nordea’s Group CIO, gave a keynote on how the ability to scale AI safely may become one of the most important competitive advantages in financial services. In this article, she expands on the themes from her keynote.

Read more

From innovation to scale: The next chapter of Nordic fintech

Tech & AI

Nordic Fintech Week 2026 is in full swing, bringing together founders, investors, fintechs and financial institutions from across the region. As an official partner of the event and sponsor of the Nordic Fintech Awards, Nordea is helping celebrate the innovation and talent driving the future of financial services.
